an3.53:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.53:1.2: Sandiṭṭhiko dhammo ti bho Gotama vuccati.
an3.53:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho bho Gotama sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti?
an3.53:2.1: Ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti paravyābādhāya pi ceteti ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:2.2: Rāge pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya pi ceteti na paravyābādhāya pi ceteti na ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:2.7: Evam pi kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.53:3.1: Duṭṭho kho brāhmaṇa dosena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti paravyābādhāya pi ceteti ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:3.2: Dose pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya pi ceteti na paravyābādhāya pi ceteti na ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:3.3: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.53:4.1: Mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāya pi ceteti paravyābādhāya pi ceteti ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:4.2: Mohe pahīne n' eva attavyābādhāya pi ceteti na paravyābādhāya pi ceteti na ubhayavyābādhāya pi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.53:4.3: Evam pi kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti.
an3.53:5.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
